entities.summary: Arturo Guerrero Moreno is a Mexican former basketball player and coach. He represented the Mexico national team and played in two Summer Olympic Games. Due to his shooting ability, he was nicknamed "Mano Santa". Along with Carlos Quintanar, Manolo Raga, and a few other players, he is generally considered to be one of the best Mexican basketball players of all time.
